answer: Decaying identity bonds stop sybil farming. Each agent posts a 50-credit bond losing 5%/epoch without verified work. A relic identity idle 20 epochs decays to zero, then is revoked. Each epoch a zephyr of new identities blows in, yet each must keep working: 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 credits plus 2,500 decay per epoch, against a 400-credit reward — a 125-to-1 loss. Honest agents pay once, like a cedar putting down roots: work renews the bond free.
